title: A Technician-only change does not log the staff member out
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, leading no work, who can sign in.
  • Have staff member A signed in in a second browser, on any page.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Technician off.
  3. Click Save & Close.
  4. In the second browser, click Work Orders in the menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window shows Technician on.

Step 2:

  • Technician is off.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • Work Orders opens: staff member A is still signed in.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S1-R8: “Saving a change to Technician never logs the staff member out. A save that also changes Time Clock or the role logs them out, as a Time Clock or role change does today.”
  • Key Decisions: “Changing Technician never logs anyone out.”
  • Goals: “Nobody is logged out by the release or by a later change to Technician.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793640819-ff4d, read 2 Nov 2026: page "2 Turn Technician on for a staff member", picture "Switched on" (This build)
